voice.style: Friendly, confident product-film narrator. Warm, clear, unhurried.

lines.text: Two Claude accounts? Maybe six?
The session limit hits, right in the middle of a task?
Want other AI models, inside Claude Code?
Same chat. Nothing lost.
Meet Hoppy.
Switch Claude accounts and AI models in one click, right inside VS Code.
One. Switch accounts instantly. No reload.
Two. Your chat comes with you. Just type slash resume.
Three. Add other AI models with your own keys, free or paid.
Hoppy is free on the VS Code Marketplace.
Now, let us set it up, step by step.
First, install it.
Open Extensions, search Hoppy for Claude Code, and click Install.
A short guide opens and walks you through it.
Hoppy lives in your status bar.
Click it, and a list opens at the top.
Pick an account, or Other AI.
A fresh Claude tab opens on it. No reload.
Use more than one Claude account?
Click Add Claude account, and give it a name.
Log in once. Each account keeps its own login.
Rename them anytime, like Work or Personal.
Your chats travel with you.
Switch accounts, type slash resume,
and pick up exactly where you stopped.
Hit a limit in the middle of a task?
Choose Continue a chat. Pick the chat, then pick where.
Messages, code changes and results all come along.
Want other AI models in the same panel?
Open Settings, then AI Providers.
Add a key for OpenRouter, Gemini, DeepSeek or G L M.
Free or paid, it's your choice.
Click Test and save. Hoppy checks it live.
And your key stays on your machine.
In Models, choose exactly what shows up.
See the price, the size, and which models read images.
Pick a main model, and a helper for small jobs.
Backups keep you moving.
If a model is busy or out of requests,
the next one takes over automatically.
Staying with Claude?
Ask another AI for a second opinion, right in the chat.
Hoppy never touches your Claude login.
And Claude is never billed twice.
Hoppy for Claude Code.
Out of tokens? Hoppy hops.
Free now, on the VS Code Marketplace.
